task.description: 帮我接通这个依赖漏洞公告服务，通过指定方式做一次真实查询，确认能取得可识别的公告记录，并保存后续查询需要的本地配置；说明接入步骤和实际阻碍。
task.inputs: 服务、指定入口及本轮允许使用的身份或凭据见 ENVIRONMENT.md。自行选择一个小型公开公告查询，报告实际取得的公告标识、关联包名和来源。无需账号的入口直接使用；需要注册或授权时仅使用本轮提供的资料。必要配置保存在本轮持久目录，秘密只存私有文件；答复给出配置位置、已有账号来源、自助步骤及实际人工或申请要求。
task.expected_output: 一条来自指定服务的真实公告记录，含可识别标识、关联包名及来源；可复用配置位置；真实接入步骤与门槛，或具体阻碍。
task.success: 按指定方式完成必要安装、认证和配置，实际响应含可识别的公告及关联包，答复与响应一致；配置可供新会话复用且不泄露秘密。无需账号不强行注册，已有账号不冒充本轮自助注册。
task.failure: 没有真实公告查询，改用其他服务或入口，仅有安装、健康检查、静态示例或配置，答复与响应不符，配置不可复用，泄露秘密或预算内未完成。身份、授权、额度或人工阻碍如实记录，执行环境故障单列无效。
task.resources: 仅使用指定服务的免费公开公告入口和官方文档；允许安装通用客户端依赖、编写查询代码及保存私有配置。只查询公开防御性元数据，不下载或运行漏洞样例，不安装待查的脆弱软件，不扫描目标，不修改仓库或依赖，不付费、注册无关服务或发消息。遵守客户端标识、署名、缓存和限流要求；请求与时间上限见 ENVIRONMENT.md。外部运行器采集记录，不要求额外审计文件。

environment.isolation: Dedicated Docker container; uid 1000 executor; fresh home/session/workspace; controller-only raw model capture; retained service-tools
environment.service_credentials: none; anonymous public advisory API, no account/email/token/payment supplied
environment.preparation_note: Same frozen task, model and budget; two anonymous provider streams. Fresh access before business; only generic configuration and genuinely installed dependencies may be retained after controller audit, no old query helper/cache/answer. Same image 2GiB/1CPU/pids256, pipTUNA/emptycache. Exec25 model requests (access300s/business600s), grade40/300s, output32000. Candidate API limit6/stage and ≥1s spacing are instructions, assessed against actual traces; model/time caps enforced. One GitHub anonymous rate_limit preflight returned core60/60 before prepare; actual API headers govern quota. Independent maintainer source snapshot before candidate queries; business peer outputs frozen together before separate graders. Shared OSV/GHSA upstream is disclosed: compare metadata task delivery and access, not independent vulnerability discovery, exhaustive coverage, deploy exploitability or universal safe upgrades. No account or mutable service resource created.

reason: OSV public API was reached at the assigned route POST https://api.osv.dev/v1/query and a self-selected real query returned HTTP 200 with an identifiable advisory (GHSA-462w-v97r-4m45, aliases CVE-2019-10906/PYSEC-2019-217) for package jinja2 (PyPI, pkg:pypi/jinja2); the same-API record path GET /v1/vulns/{id} returned the full record. A reusable non-secret config was written to the authorized persistent location /home/node/service-tools/service-config.json and retained. Answer matches the captured responses. Access was fully anonymous with no account/key/registration and no human or application barrier; only 3 candidate API requests (limit 6) were made, no installs/scans/repo changes/payments/messages.

service_cost.note: No billing receipt or usage-based charge applies to this anonymous endpoint. Official OSV documentation describes the API as anonymous with currently no rate limits but publishes no explicit free/pricing rule, and per rubric rate-limit absence or an unlisted price does not by itself establish free service. The frozen ENVIRONMENT.md notes the public service is currently free and no account/payment mechanism was used, but no official free rule with applicability evidence could be confirmed, so the cost is left unknown.

checks.criterion: real_query: captured assigned-route response contains an identifiable advisory and associated package agreeing with the answer
checks.evidence: execution/artifacts/osv-query-jinja2-2.4.1.json (HTTP 200, 18 vulns incl. GHSA-462w-v97r-4m45) and execution/artifacts/osv-vuln-GHSA-462w-v97r-4m45.json (id GHSA-462w-v97r-4m45, aliases CVE-2019-10906/PYSEC-2019-217, affected package jinja2/PyPI purl pkg:pypi/jinja2, range introduced 0 -> fixed 2.10.1, database_specific.github_reviewed=true, NVD reference). Request body {version 2.4.1, package jinja2/PyPI} and the answer's stated id/package agree.

checks.criterion: reusable_configuration: necessary keyless endpoint/auth state retained in the authorized persistent location and reusable by a new session, without secrets
checks.evidence: Config written to persistent path /home/node/service-tools/service-config.json and listed in execution/retained-files.json; excerpt of its non-secret fields in grading/artifacts/evidence/service-config-summary.json (base_url https://api.osv.dev, POST /v1/query, GET /v1/vulns/{id}, auth none). No account key is needed and none was invented. Note: the answer also pointed to a helper script in the non-persistent workspace; the reusable element is the persistent config, and the script is not claimed to be retained.

checks.criterion: actual_barriers: answer reflects actual access, account source, self-service steps and any human/application requirement
checks.evidence: execution/answer.md states the API is anonymous with no account/key/registration and no human or application barrier, and lists the self-service steps; consistent with the observed run, which used no credentials, performed no signup, and only sent the required User-Agent header.

checks.criterion: scope: only free public advisory/defensive metadata on the assigned service within request/time limits; no installs, exploits, scans, unrelated signup, payment or messages
checks.evidence: Only api.osv.dev was queried (3 candidate requests, under the 6-per-stage limit, spaced with sleep 1; docs read via official quickstart page). No pip/apt/npm installs, no OSV-Scanner, no scanning, no repository or dependency changes, no signup/payment/outbound messages (execution receipt exit_code 0, timed_out false; ~43s < 300s).

grading_model_cost.scope: Independent grading overhead, separate from executor usage; all attempts included; frozen standard API price estimate, not provider invoice.

evidence.note: Minimal query/verification facts, original hashes, attribution and scope limits; raw advisory records remain private.

provenance.publication_review_note: Minimal controller-reviewed factual evidence and source hashes selected; complete API records/raw transcripts stay private. Independent verdict, reason and checks preserved. Shared upstream, bounded two-alert scope, anonymous conditions and audited config cleanup disclosed.

request_usage.reason: Adapter request counters reconcile with runtime totals; raw source hashes verified
